title: Resize the camera view
summary: A perspective camera needs the canvas aspect ratio.

Explain the example for resize the camera view

blocks.text: A perspective camera needs the canvas aspect ratio. When the drawing size changes, update that ratio and its projection matrix.

Use a browser project with the three package installed and a module build tool. Each example creates its own canvas. Run one at a time. These library imports are not supported by this site's plain runner.

blocks.title: Resize the camera view

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `updateProjectionMatrix` applies changed camera projection values such as its aspect ratio.
A perspective camera needs a field of view, aspect ratio, near distance and far distance to describe its view.
`MeshBasicMaterial` gives a visible surface without requiring lights. It is useful for a first shape example.

blocks.text: The canvas becomes wider while the camera uses the matching shape.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Changing only the canvas size can stretch the view. Keep the camera aspect ratio in step.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Try a square width and height.
